322 native witnesses in 23 problems: `MANIFEST.json` (SHA-256 of every file) and `records/<problem>_nNN.json`. Each beats the current certified coordinate record (main at e0fc321, 2026-10-25) by more than 1e-12: 0.0013 % to 18.59 %, median 0.56 %. All pass `verify_general.py` (VALID) and `certify_general.py` (CERTIFIED), unmodified from e0fc321, run as the workflow runs them (Python 3.12). Wall gaps >= 1.00e-07, pair gaps >= 8.18e-08 (verify_general.py).

**Method and lineage.** The code, searches and constructions were made with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), with Michael Sinko directing. Every record comes from a search started from a packing of this repository at cbf76f2f, named in each `source_credit` with its `found_by`, `credit` and `method` verbatim; `found_by` adds "(search started from the packing of <lineage>)". 302 use PolyPack's warm search (packages/polyhedra/src/search.ts at 54e3ca2; seed 1, 150,000 evaluations); 20 use PolyPack's compute study of 2026-10-23 (basin hopping; cubes in a tetrahedron n = 41-44 by inserting cubes one at a time into PingYou Ltd's n = 40 packing). 27 delete pieces from a result for a larger n.
